notes.title: Realms of Madness
notes.notes:
Dear Knights and Dames,

After two years of quiet creation, I am thrilled to invite you into a new adventure—[i]Realms of Madness[/i], a mysterious fantasy castlebuilder that pushes beyond the familiar into strange and untamed realms. A free demo is available now, ready for you to explore.

In Realms of Madness, you’ll command new fantastical units like mighty trolls and fearsome dragons. Combat has been carefully streamlined for sharper strategy, and castlebuilding offers fresh depth and refinement.

Your feedback means the world to us. To all the bold Realm Hunters out there—step into the madness, try the [b]free demo[/b], and let us know your thoughts!

Check out [b]Realms of Madness[/b] on Steam now! Thank you :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38011159/5f5ccf58698b8352b0fc417311c99c4a3fef07b0.jpg[/img]

Your journey begins here.

Kind regards,
Robin van der Horst.
- Developer.

notes.title: Open The Gates into the Realms of Madness!
notes.notes:
Dear Knights and Dames,

As some of you may have seen, I have been working on a new game called "Realms of Madness". Similar to 'Open The Gates!', it is a sidescroller castlebuilder RTS but this time it will contain more fantasy elements and be generally much better in every regard. I learned a ton from making 'Open The Gates!' and all of that experience will be poured into this next game. That's why I am super happy to show you the trailer for [b]Realms of Madness[/b]

[b]New Trailer[/b]
[previewyoutube=OA9NDG4grOc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Open The Gates to the Realms of Madness!
notes.notes:
[i]Dear Knights and Dames,

Word has reached us from another kingdom far away. Portals from strange dimensions have opened and they are looking for someone to enter... 

Foolish if you ask me! But if you are up to the challenge... I suggest you join.

Kind regards,
The Advisor[/i]

[h2]Realms of Madness[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38011159/b15f0b9dbb34613ab95b2fa1b6ba7e4575ae37e8.png[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Dominate the skies with the aid of birds and winged beasts. Engage in ground battles deploying soldiers, wizards, trolls, and siege equipment. Command the seas utilizing ships and subaquatic creatures.
[*]Raise powerful walls enhanced with modular upgrades like fire braziers, traps, and towers.
[*]Attain chaotic abilities by investing ability points earned during combat.
[*]Deploy squad-based soldier formations that can accumulate experience. Preserve their lives, and they will progressively increase in skill.
[*]Conjure extremely powerful dragons in the late game.
[*]Collaborate with friends or engage in fierce battles against each other in online multiplayer.
[*]Interact through dialogue with fully voice-acted characters.
[/list]

[h2]Add to your wishlist![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2501920/Realms_of_Madness/

notes.title: Strategy Fest Discount
notes.notes:
[i]Dear Knights and Dames,

Many have embarked on this quest since October 16th. However, many more are needed to vanguish the evil bastards once and for all! That's why the emperor, and I, have decided to reduce the recruitment fee by 40% during the Steam jousting tournament (officially known as 'Steam Strategy Fest 2023'). This event will take place from Augustus 28th until September 4th starting at 10AM pacific time.

May your conquests lead to glory!

Open The Gates! To War We Go!

Yours sincerely,
The Advisor[/i]

notes.title: What are you all thinking about the game?
notes.notes:
[b]The King is looking for your thoughts on this quest.[/b]

[i]Dear Knights and Dames,

The king has requested a kingdom wide audit of all noble warriors recruited to recapture the kingdom. The noble king is curious how many of you actually managed to reclaim his empire. He also wishes to know what about his quest was not up to your liking. Who were the villains that stumbled you? What problems were encountered along the way?

Please leave your thoughts and feedback on the discussion forums. It will be used to improve the experience and create future updates! Your input is greatly appreciated. May the future be bright!

Kind regards,
The Advisor[/i]

notes.title: Balance Patch 2
notes.notes:
Second balance patch adressing some more balance related issues. As well as some smaller improvements.

[list]
[*]Reduced frequency of attacks in level 4 of world 2.
[*]Attacks in level 4 of world 2 will now no longer occur just as the player is winning. Should make the level more fair and fun.
[*]Changed the knight charge visual.
[*]Changed exploding bolts and maceman smash ability because the previous balance patch made enemy flying units always die causing these two abilities to become significantly overpowered. Please let me know whether you feel the abilities are now under or overpowered. 
[/list]

notes.title: Balance Patch 1
notes.notes:
[i]This will be the first in a series of balance patches to address the sometimes crazy balance in the game :)[/i]
[list]
[*]Flying enemy units will now die instead of pile-up near the enemy castle. Should help make long matches more fair.
[*]Changed the description for the horse knights to make the charge ability more clear.
[*]Nerfed the enemy attack rate in level 2 of world 3. 
[/list]

notes.title: Update! Preview Enemy Army
notes.notes:
[b]Preview Enemy Army![/b]

This update adds a new button that allows you to see what enemy army is about to attack you. This should allow you to more easily anticipate the next attack. This feature can be turned off in the options panel if you dislike the additional space covered up by the timer in the top left hand corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38011159/4981e3e9d9a1ff5095e85cb4d717bfde09f4e652.png[/img]

notes.title: Minor Update 1.0.11
notes.notes:
[i]Hey,  here is another small update while I am working on a major update.[/i]

[list]
[*]Made level 19 more fair. The game will now try to accomodate players who aren't as quick with building an outpost on another island.
[*]Fixed a crash issue reported by a user.
[*]Some miscellaneous changes.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update 1.0.10
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Right clicking to cancel placement of structure no longer moves selected units.
[*]Left clicking to place structure no longer de-selects units.
[*]Slightly changed siege timings in level 1 world 3. (This is minor but makes the level slightly more difficult)
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update 1.0.9
notes.notes:
[b]Update addresses issues related to balancing brought up by players. I appreciate their feedback enormously![/b]

[list]
[*]Balanced level 5 of world 2. This should now be much easier on 'very easy', 'easy' and 'normal' while remaining mostly the same on 'hard' and 'extreme'.
[*]Balanced level 1 of world 3. A user reported this level was too difficult on 'normal' and after playtesting I agreed. This is now easier.
[*]Updated the explanation for the crime system because a user rightly reported inconsistencies. 
[/list]

My apologies for these mistakes. Please keep reporting problems whenever you find them!

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Timings in world 3 and world 4 were quite difficult on normal mode. These have been adjusted so it should be a more 'relaxed' experience.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes: Level 4 was insanely difficult on hard mode due to a mistake in timings,

notes.title: Minor Update 1.0.8
notes.notes:
[b]Update aims to address balancing issues. Practically, this update makes the game easier across the board.[/b]

[list]
[*]Difficulty setting now effects the duration between attacks. On easy modes you will have more time to prepare and on difficult modes you will have less.
[*]Generously extended timings in level 5 of world 2 because of user-reported issues with balancing.
[*]Enemy applefarms now have their correct animation.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update 1.0.7
notes.notes:
[b]Minor Update 1.0.7[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed a crash reported by a user.
[/list]

I am currently working on Battle Mode. This will include random world generation and a whole new villain! This is going to be a great addition.

notes.title: Minor Update 1.0.6
notes.notes:
[b]User reported difficulties progressing to next levels. This update aims to address that.[/b]

In order to win you needed to destroy both all enemy structures as well as all enemy units. This update changes this so enemy units that are not attacking are not counted towards victory. This means you can win without having to hunt down all enemy units.

notes.title: Minor Update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
[b]Minor Update 1.0.5[/b]

[list]
[*]Waypoints are now color coded. Have text to indicate they are in fact waypoints and show a dashed line to their structure.
[*]Crossbowmen have been buffed.
[*]Volley ability has been nerfed.
[*]Decreases siege frequency in level 1, 2, 3 and 4.
[*]Reinforcements in level 5 now arrive 10 seconds earlier.
[*]Generally made the first world more manageable.
[/list]

As we are getting further away from the launch date I am starting to look towards the first major update. Many have asked for a mode where you have all units unlocked. 

[b]Skirmish (or battle) mode will be coming soon![/b]

notes.title: Minor Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
[b]Version 1.0.4[/b]

There have been performance issues for users with devices that contain both a dedicated graphics card as well as an integrated graphics card. The game should automatically prefer the dedicated card to provide a smooth experience but this was not the case in 1.0.3. This was, however, the case in 1.0.2. This update fixed the problem of 1.0.3.

Please report any performance issues to 'openthegatesgame@outlook.com', I will respond within hours.

notes.title: Minor Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[b]Update aims to adress some performance issues on lower end devices using Integrated Graphics. Please use a Dedicated Graphics card if possible![/b]

[list]
[*]Game now automatically sets vsync setting based on display refresh rate. Eg. if refresh rate is not 60hz vsync will be automatically enabled when the game is first launched. If the setting is manually adjusted, it will not be re-adjusted by the game.
[*]Anti-aliasing is now disabled by default. This was causing performance issues on lower end devices.
[*]Optimized menu buttons (especially checkboxes).
[*]Minor additional optimizations.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[b]Fixed crash reported 37 minutes ago;[/b]
"Unable to find any instance for object index '-4' name '<undefined>'"

notes.title: Minor Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a rare crash issue when destroying a wooden wall.
[*]Fixed replacement outposts being placed incorrectly in siege mode worlds 4 and 6.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Patch Notes
notes.notes: Included a temporary fix to an uncommon crash situation. Thank you to everyone who reported.

notes.title: Open The Gates! is now available.
notes.notes:
[i]Dear Knights and Dames,

It is with great pleasure and furious excitement that I, your advisor, invite you to join our cause. The journey ahead is full of exciting battles and desperate last stands. But in the end, you will prevail. 

Open The Gates! To War We Go!

Yours sincerely,
- The Advisor

ps. please knock thrice when you arrive at our castle.[/i]

notes.notes:
[i]Dear Knights and Dames,

Today, the time has finally come.  Pick up your sword and your bow and report to the emperor. I cannot yet say what awaits you but let's just say... it isn't good.

We need your help!

Yours sincerely,
- The Advisor

ps. When you arrive at our castle, please knock thrice. [/i]

notes.title: Open The Gates! is launching on October 17th 2022!
notes.notes:
Dear Knights and Dames

[i]The time has finally come, 

Open The Gates! will launch on October 17th 2022 at 6AM Pacific Time. Anyone who reads this, you now have but one task; to remember! 

Here's some help; think of a pink elephant. Now, going forward, whenever you think of a pink elephant, think of this game! Now don't forget the pink elephant. (Or just add the game to your wishlist!)[/i]

Kind Regards,
The Advisor

notes.title: The quest is about to begin...
notes.notes:
Dear Knights and Dames,

I, the Advisor, bring a message from The Jester.

"[i]In about a month from now, you will be able to play a game that is so amazing you will say to yourself: [b]Wow! That was not as bad as I thought![/b] Do you want to play this game? Then put it on your wishlist because the Gates are Opening very soon![/i]"

The exact release date will be announced in the near future. Stay tuned!

Thank you for your consideration,
- The Advisor

notes.title: Demo is now available!
notes.notes:
Dear Knights and Dames,

The time has arrived. You will now get to step foot into our world. Build a castle and fend off enemy armies! Then let us know what you thought of it in the community forum.

Yours sincerely,
- The Advisor

ps. When you arrive at our castle please knock twice.

notes.title: Free demo coming June 13th!
notes.notes:
Dear Knights and Dames,

[i]"It was during the heat of battle
when the emperor tended to his dairy cattle.

It was when the enemy knocked down our gates
that the emperor dropped his golden dinner plates.

It was when our soldiers lay shattered next to their shields
that the emperor was playing golf in the fields.

It was when our farms were wholly aflame
that the emperor finally came...

As his empire fell, he watched
Turns out ruling is a task
- that he botched.

And he botched it bad.

Again."[/i]

On June 13th I am urging all of you to report to the Emperor's Castle. Apparently the Emperor is looking for someone to reclaim his empire. Will you join our great emperor's cause? Will you battle the notorious Feeble The Weak on the sunflower fields?

Then join us on June 13th and experience what it is like to build a sidescrolling castle. And who knows? Perhaps you are suited for a larger quest... We'll see if you've got what it takes. 

Open The Gates! To War We Go!

- The Advisor
